metadata.description: Bailey Ranch Golf Club, located just minutes North of Tulsa in Owasso, offers one of Oklahoma's best tests of golf and is considered to be one of the most fun courses to play in the region. The links style layout offers an outstanding variety of memorable holes which wind their way through creeks, lakes, trees, thickets, and native grassland. Host of the National Golf Associations NGA Hooters Pro Tour, Bailey Ranch can challenge the very best golfers. There are four sets of tees so the golfer can choose just how challenging they would like to make their round. A full practice facility complete with green side bunkers allows you to warm up properly for the par 72 round of golf. Bailey Ranch offers affordable green fees for golf as well as friendly, first-class service. So come out to Owasso and discover for yourself why it is one of the best courses in the area.

metadata.description: 18-hole public golf course, sparkling pool and deluxe meeting facilities, coupled with an endless variety of recreational activities amidst an inviting resort community, make Forest Ridge the perfect community.  The golf course begins with a beautiful starting hole that has its compliment of mounds, grass depressions, bunkers and a lake to give the player a preview of things to come. This fantastic course ends at the 18 where the trees are set back in a wooded area that opens up to the fairway the length of the fairway on the left. A solid tee shot up the left side will give the player an opportunity to reach this green in two.  This course is designed to challenge and excite golfers of all ages and levels.
